question: What is the exact rawValue of ManagedSettingsStore.Name.default on iOS 26.1?
reason: The symbol graph documents only "The default store name." This port uses the identifier string default. An Apple-oracle probe is required before treating that string as ABI.

question: Are CookiePolicy raw strings the Swift case names (never, currentWebsite, visitedWebsites, always) or the MDM PascalCase tokens (Never, CurrentWebsite, VisitedWebsites, Always)?
reason: The graph records RawValue = String with no explicit raw values. Implicit Swift assignment was used. MDM safari.settings.yaml lists PascalCase AcceptCookies tokens, which may be a different layer.

question: Are ShieldAction integer raw values the implicit 0/1 declaration-order values, or explicit Apple integers?
reason: API digester lists primaryButtonPressed then secondaryButtonPressed with no numeric literals. Runtime confirmation is needed.

question: Are ShieldActionResponse integer raw values the implicit 0/1/2 declaration-order values for none/close/defer?
reason: Same as ShieldAction: no explicit raw values in the pinned graph.

question: What keyed or unkeyed Codable layout does Apple persist for Token<T>, and does decoding Family Controls picker tokens succeed only inside an authorized process?
reason: Token has no public initializer besides Decoder. This port round-trips a Linux-only linuxOpaqueID UUID and fail-closes on any other payload. Copying an Apple token blob must not be invented.

question: What ShieldActionResponse does the un-overridden ShieldActionDelegate.handle method pass to its completion handler on iOS, and on which queue?
reason: No default is documented. Linux invokes the handler synchronously with .none (no additional system action) because there is no shield UI host.

question: When several named stores set different maximumMovieRating values, what merge rule produces effectiveMaximumMovieRating, and does an unauthorized app still observe the metadata default of 1000?
reason: The graph says that if no maximumMovieRating settings are active the property is the metadata default. Family Controls authorization and daemon merge behavior are unobserved. Linux never activates a rating policy.

question: Does ManagedSettingsStore persist settings across process launches via a daemon, and which entitlement is required before writes apply as device restrictions?
reason: Named stores share in-process maps on Linux only. Applying Screen Time / Family Controls restrictions would fabricate Apple-service success.

question: Does Application.init(bundleIdentifier:) return that string from the bundleIdentifier getter outside a ManagedSettingsUI shield-configuration extension, or is the getter always nil outside that extension?
reason: The property doc says the value is nil outside the shield-configuration extension. This port retains caller-supplied identifiers from init(bundleIdentifier:) so clients can form blockedApplications sets, and keeps token-constructed instances nil.
